changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Whiteboard identity linked to the existing shared page

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Stable board identity; references the shared core.page

column.name: published_version_id
column.remarks: Current published version; null before first publication

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Original creator's externally owned actor identity; independent of current page ownership

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Original whiteboard creation time

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Full Yjs state at a durable log boundary; creation supplies the initial snapshot through sequence zero

column.name: id
column.remarks: Application-generated immutable snapshot identity

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Whiteboard owning this snapshot

column.name: through_sequence
column.remarks: Highest update sequence included in the full state; zero for the initial snapshot

column.name: state_bytes
column.remarks: Complete encoded Yjs state; even an empty board requires a valid Yjs encoding

column.name: state_digest
column.remarks: SHA-256 of state_bytes, formatted as sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

column.name: title
column.remarks: Title captured at the same document boundary; title changes must participate in the ordered document state

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Application actor associated with snapshot creation

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Snapshot materialization time

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_snapshot ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_snapshot_sequence_ck CHECK (through_sequence >= 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_snapshot_bytes_ck CHECK (octet_length(state_bytes) > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_snapshot_digest_format_ck CHECK (state_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$');

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: One stable draft per board, reconstructed from its base snapshot and subsequent updates

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Stable draft identity; primary key enforces at most one draft per board

column.name: base_snapshot_id
column.remarks: Snapshot from which incremental replay starts; must belong to this board

column.name: head_sequence
column.remarks: Last committed update position; creation starts at zero

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: Creator initially; actor of latest accepted append subsequently

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Creation time initially; latest append time subsequently

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_draft ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_draft_sequence_ck CHECK (head_sequence >= 0);

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Creation retry receipts independent of a client-known page ID; insert atomically with the board

column.name: actor_id
column.remarks: Authenticated caller; scopes the idempotency key

column.name: space_id
column.remarks: Destination space; scopes the idempotency key

column.name: idempotency_key
column.remarks: Client-generated key retained across retries of one create action

column.name: request_hash
column.remarks: SHA-256 of the normalized creation request; detects key reuse with different content

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Whiteboard created by this request

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Receipt creation time; no expiry until a safe retry-retention policy exists

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_create_receipt ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_create_receipt_hash_ck CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$');

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Grant application access explicitly; core schema defaults do not apply to the new schema
